name: The grumpy old neighbour (There's a catch EP07, Only you remember): striped bathrobe, pink curlers, fluffy slippers
source: storyboards/series/what-if/07-fire-rewind/DESIGN.md 4.2 (13 Nov 2026), Jonny's board panels 09 and 15; a variant file in the way characters/what-if/viking-old.json is
personality: The grumpy old neighbour (EP07 proposal): half-lidded, disappointed in everyone, sure the kid is playing a trick. Opens his door a crack and sends Spud away; later jabs a glove at him in front of the whole building.
voiceNote: a placeholder (low, slow, creaky) until the director's proposal to Jonny: not designed in T3
notes: Same skin (#e2a95c) and glove as Spud, a little taller (0.92) and wider (0.80). The curlers and the robe are the bathrobe type of costumes-everyday.js. The face neutral is the design's 'grumpy' (curve -0.35, brows -0.45, eye 0.8) written as JSON neutral numbers on the 'kind' default, since a new named expression would be an engine face change.
